why: Locked-off shot of a highway at a misty blue dawn: a white semi with a dark trailer comes out of the haze and passes, then a pickup and distant trucks follow. It already has the cool grey-blue of services.webp, so it keeps the same grade family, and it reads as calm, premium freight with no people, logos, readable plates or text. Graded from the pale stock look (luma 161) to steel slate: gamma .72, contrast 1.12, saturation .72, soft vignette. Mean luma is 89 vs 70 on services.webp, and the page scrim darkens it further. Mirrored horizontally so vehicles travel on the right half and exit right, away from the bottom-left headline. Loop: 1080p source frames 158-358 with the last 14 frames (0.58 s) crossfaded into frames 144-157 (rounded blend, no luma dip), then rotated so it starts at the semi mid-approach. 201 frames = 8.38 s. The seam step of 1.24 is below the p95 motion step of 1.65. Poster = video frame 0 (the semi centred at x≈0.46), so nothing jumps when playback starts. focusX .5 keeps the vehicles' path in a portrait crop
